calculation.description: Contrarian signal that favors instruments closing near the low of their recent daily ranges. The five-session mean close-location value is lagged one completed session; a negative close-location average produces a positive reversal score. Zero-range sessions are treated as missing and the cross-section is forward-filled only after calculation.

validation.regime_notes: Positive full-sample and recent IC across the 15-asset cross-asset universe; strongest recent performance, with shorter-horizon decay and no apparent 20-session persistence. Interpret uncertainty conservatively because average coverage is approximately 12 instruments.
